name: Fylax
sum: A late-surviving hadrosauroid from the Maastrichtian Figuerola Formation of Spain, known from a nearly complete left dentary.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A nearly complete left dentary from the Figuerola Formation, Spain.
biology: The name means "keeper"; no habits are described in the sources consulted.
author: Prieto-Márquez and Carrera Farias 2021
